entries.title: Rotating Sandpaper Disk Wearing Down a Color-Layered Block
entries.description: A spinning disk (sandpaper texture) slowly grinds away a multi-layer colored cube, with dust particles emitting, the cube shrinking and changing color as layers are exposed, and a wear-depth meter updating over time.
